name: Atrium building / 01
description: Three furnished office floors with a central glazed atrium, private stone façades, solid wing roofs, CEO and boardroom balconies, and a landscaped entrance. Includes 57 scheduled exit signs, 27 portable extinguisher stations with paired signs, and nine refitted washrooms. HVAC, plumbing and rooftop equipment are conceptual; planned BMS points are unavailable until connected.
